```{r}
#| include: false
BM <- if (isTRUE(subduction)) "BM17" else "BM19"
BM.code <- paste0(intToUtf8(96), BM, intToUtf8(96))
```

- **Newmark Permanent Displacements.** The Newmark permanent displacement $D_n$ quantifies the displacement induced by an earthquake and accumulated in the sliding mass and is the performance measure from which the seismic coefficients are derived. The $D_n(k_y)$ curves relate, for each combination of geometry, material, and design scenario, the yield acceleration $k_y$ to the expected permanent displacement; they were computed with the `ensemble` set of `AM88`, `JB07`, `SR08`, `BT07`, and `r BM.code`, with the reference magnitude assigned to each seismic demand and `r .fmti(NS)` realizations per demand and are read at the fractiles $q = 1 - p_e$.

```{r}
#| include: false
rm(list = intersect(c("BM", "BM.code"), ls()))
```
